description: Download the WHOLE website as editable JSON: every page with its full blocks (headers, hero, sections, CTAs, ad blocks, footers, text, colours) plus an imageManifest that lists every image and exactly where it sits. This is the fast way to let the user's AI edit an entire template at once — edit the JSON, then push it back with apply_site. Use JSON (not CSV) for site structure; use product_csv(action="export") for the product catalogue.

includeImageManifest.description: Include a flat list of every image with its page/block location and current URL.

name: export_site
